purpose: This is a homeopathic preparation that some people use to try to prevent or reduce symptoms of the H3N2 strain of the flu virus. It is used as an alternative or complementary approach during flu season. It is important to know that there is no scientific evidence proving it works like a conventional flu vaccine or antiviral medication.
how_it_works: In homeopathic theory, a nosode is made from a highly diluted form of the actual virus or disease material, in this case the H3N2 influenza virus. The idea is that this extreme dilution may stimulate your body's own natural defenses. However, conventional science does not support this mechanism, and the dilution used in homeopathy is so extreme that essentially no original substance remains.
common_side_effects: Homeopathic remedies at these extreme dilutions are generally considered very safe with minimal side effects. Some people report a temporary mild worsening of symptoms at first, which homeopaths call a 'healing response.' Allergic reactions are very rare.
warnings: This product is NOT a replacement for the conventional flu vaccine, which is proven to be safe and effective. If you are elderly, pregnant, immunocompromised, or have chronic health conditions, please talk to your doctor before using this product. Do not delay proven medical treatment in favor of this remedy. The FDA does not evaluate homeopathic products for effectiveness.
typical_dosing: Dosing varies by brand and manufacturer. A common homeopathic approach is to take small pellets dissolved under the tongue, often once daily during flu season or as directed on the product label. Always follow the specific instructions on the package or consult a homeopathic practitioner.
